widgets_values: Convert the characters in the image into a character table, arrange the view horizontally to maintain consistency, have a transparent background, and achieve ultra-high definition. The overall consists of four parts, namely: front facial close-up, front full body view, side full body view, and back full body view. The specific requirements are as follows: front facial close-up view: occupying one-third of the width of the entire view, the view is a close-up view of the person's front face, visible from the top of the person's head to the chest, with the body facing the camera and looking at the camera. Front full body view, side full body view, and back full body view: occupying 2/9 of the entire view width respectively, the view can see the top of the person's head to the bottom of the feet, including the front full body view and side full body view, including the facial part.
